source_gate.historical_runtime_boundary: exact published bytes after verified inverse of all registered late source stages

geometry_gate.apple_import_negative_boundary: Runs only with Apple Swift; Linux Foundation differs.

physical_limits: UIKit snapshot pixels, native AVKit compositor and physical top/bottom corner animation are not exercised by adapters. On iOS15–17.3 rendering status plus a display turn is a best-effort fallback, not a strict displayed-frame signal.
